description: This file defines various kernel packages for the OpenWrt Linux distribution, specifying modules for MediaTek chipsets such as PWM, SDHCI, I2C controllers, DMA engines, and sound drivers. It uses Makefile syntax with macros to declare kernel modules, dependencies, file paths, and descriptions.
